args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of v2.3.1 to production, checkout-api failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of about 18%. v2.3.1 (and its staging candidate v2.3.1-rc) were both marked unhealthy. checkout-api was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with an error rate of about 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions, and the service is healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Cause:** v2.3.1, the latest release, was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an error rate of about 18%.
- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release marked healthy in production. I didn't go back further to v2.2.9.
- **Result:** All three regions are now on v2.3.0. The service reports healthy, with the error rate down to about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback, the health check after it, and a follow-up to find what went wrong in v2.3.1 before it's deployed again.

The test version of this release in staging (v2.3.1-rc) was also marked unhealthy. The release seems to have gone to production despite that, so it's worth raising in the incident review.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
